title: Mirabel and the Glasshouse
author: Coral Winterbourne
blurb: Wren Vane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
